shortDescription: Manages VRRP interfaces on HUAWEI CloudEngine devices.

options.name: admin_flowdown
options.description: Disable the flowdown function for service VRRP.

options.name: admin_ignore_if_down
options.description: mVRRP ignores an interface Down event.

options.name: admin_interface
options.description: Tracked mVRRP interface name. The value is a string of 1 to 63 characters.

options.name: admin_vrid
options.description: Tracked mVRRP ID. The value is an integer ranging from 1 to 255.

options.name: advertise_interval
options.description: Configured interval between sending advertisements, in milliseconds. Only the master router sends VRRP advertisements. The default value is 1000 milliseconds.

options.name: auth_key
options.description: This object is set based on the authentication type. When noAuthentication is specified, the value is empty. When simpleTextPassword or md5Authentication is specified, the value is a string of 1 to 8 characters in plaintext and displayed as a blank text for security.

options.name: auth_mode
options.description: Authentication type used for VRRP packet exchanges between virtual routers. The values are noAuthentication, simpleTextPassword, md5Authentication. The default value is noAuthentication.

options.name: fast_resume
options.description: mVRRP's fast resume mode.

options.name: gratuitous_arp_interval
options.description: Interval at which gratuitous ARP packets are sent, in seconds. The value ranges from 30 to 1200.The default value is 300.

options.name: holding_multiplier
options.description: The configured holdMultiplier.The value is an integer ranging from 3 to 10. The default value is 3.

options.name: interface
options.description: Name of an interface. The value is a string of 1 to 63 characters.

options.name: is_plain
options.description: Select the display mode of an authentication key. By default, an authentication key is displayed in ciphertext.

options.name: preempt_timer_delay
options.description: Preemption delay. The value is an integer ranging from 0 to 3600. The default value is 0.

options.name: priority
options.description: Configured VRRP priority. The value ranges from 1 to 254. The default value is 100. A larger value indicates a higher priority.

options.name: recover_delay
options.description: Delay in recovering after an interface goes Up. The delay is used for interface flapping suppression. The value is an integer ranging from 0 to 3600. The default value is 0 seconds.

options.name: state
options.description: Specify desired state of the resource.

options.name: version
options.description: VRRP version. The default version is v2.

options.name: virtual_ip
options.description: Virtual IP address. The value is a string of 0 to 255 characters.

options.name: vrid
options.description: VRRP backup group ID. The value is an integer ranging from 1 to 255.

options.name: vrrp_type
options.description: Type of a VRRP backup group.
